# Credit Card Forgiveness - Programs & Options [2026]
> Last updated: 2026-09-25

> What is credit card forgiveness program? How does credit card forgiveness work? Is credit card debt forgiveness real? Can credit card debt be forgiven?

## About
creditcardforgiveness.org is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.
